name: Apex Apes
summary:
Apex Apes is a VR multiplayer platformer hangout where you can swing, jump, and explore with friends in a fun and immersive world! Customize your Ape with a variety of cosmetics, unlock unique items, and show off your style to the community.

Our game offers exciting features like:

Multiplayer VR gameplay with smooth movement

Customizable cosmetics for your Ape, including head, body, and face items

Fun hangout areas to explore with friends

Events, challenges, and special rewards for active players
